fine_lines.title: short vs long
fine_lines.explanation_ar: short = قصير. long = طويل. Short on the sides and long on the top = قصير على الجانبين وطويل في الأعلى.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Short" is not long. "Short on the sides, long on top" is a common haircut.

examples.sentence: Make it short on the sides.
Keep it long on the top.

fine_lines.title: feel vs look vs smell
fine_lines.explanation_ar: feels = الإحساس باللمس. looks = الشكل. smells = الرائحة.

expressions.phrase: How can I help you today?
expressions.example: Hello! How can I help you today?

expressions.phrase: I want a haircut and a shave.
expressions.example: I just want a haircut, please.

expressions.meaning_ar: من فضلك اجلس على هذا الكرسي.
expressions.example: Please sit in this chair. It won't take long.

expressions.phrase: What kind of haircut do you want?
expressions.example: What kind of haircut do you want today?

expressions.phrase: Make it short on the sides and long on the top.
expressions.meaning_ar: اجعله قصيرًا على الجانبين وطويلًا في الأعلى.
expressions.example: Make it short on the back, please.

expressions.phrase: Do you want a wash too?
expressions.example: Do you want a wash too? No, thank you.

expressions.phrase: Look at the mirror. / Take a look now.
expressions.meaning_ar: انظر في المرآة. / ألقِ نظرة الآن.
expressions.example: It's finished. Take a look now.

expressions.phrase: I am glad you like it.
expressions.example: "This is perfect!" "I am glad you like it."

expressions.phrase: Would you like me to do that?
expressions.example: I can add some gel. Would you like me to do that?

expressions.phrase: Thank you for the excellent service today.
expressions.example: Thank you for the excellent service.

grammar.title: make + object + adjective
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم make + الشيء + صفة لنقول كيف نريد أن يصبح: Make it short.
grammar.explanation_en: Use "make + object + adjective" to say how you want something to become.
examples: Make it short on the sides.
I will make your face smooth.
The gel makes my hair look fresh.

grammar.title: Would you like (me to) ...?
grammar.explanation_ar: لعرض شيء: Would you like a hot towel? ولعرض أن تفعل شيئًا: Would you like me to + فعل?
grammar.explanation_en: Offer a thing: "Would you like a hot towel?" Offer to do something: "Would you like me to + verb?"
examples: Would you like a hot towel?
Would you like me to do that?
Would you like me to style your hair?

questions.question: A "barbershop" is a place where men ...
I will use the ____ for that. (an electric tool for short hair)
My face feels so ____. (no hair, soft)
Would you like ____ to do that?
questions.explanation_ar: الإجابة الصحيحة: Would you like me to.
questions.explanation_en: We say "Would you like me to ...?"
